title: Cliff Sosin - Investing in Carvana - [Invest Like the Best, EP.421]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Cliff is the founder of CAS Investment Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Cliff is the founder of CAS Investment Partners. At the time, CAS had only four positions. This conversation is different to our typical episodes. We start by talking about Cliff's investing philosophy but the bulk of this long discussion is a case study into his remarkable investment in Carvana.

key_points.text: Cliff is the founder of CAS Investment Partners.
Cliff is one of the biggest investors in the business, which had a market cap over $60 billion in 2021, then fell 99%, survived.
While I hosted Carvana's CEO, Ernie Garcia, last year to get the inside perspective on managing through such turbulence.
